spec.title: Super El Niño! Why is Singapore so hot and dry?
spec.endChip: 🌏 TheOneApp, Explored · a new episode every Thursday
spec.wc_before: Let's name what you saw. Water gains heat and evaporates into water vapour. Water vapour loses heat and condenses into tiny water droplets, which form clouds. The droplets fall as rain. That is the water cycle. El Niño does not stop the water cycle. It moves where the rain falls.
